cond_0001.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. Requires having the ability to run & review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, Harmonic studies.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs.
Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes.
Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time.
Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation.
Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations.
This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
7 - 10 Years in related field
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check
Requires Offshore travel
Preferred Requirements
Offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection

cond_0038.responsibilities:
Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs.
Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time.
Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis' to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation.
Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB).
Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations.
This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.

Proven track record in offshore environments with deep knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.
Extensive expertise in the design, operation, protection, and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery, power switchboards, protection and control equipment, VFDs, DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, and Energy Storage systems.
Advanced knowledge of Profibus/Profinet communication systems.
Strong command of power systems analysis including Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.

cond_0060.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection, and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, energy storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) short-circuit, protective devices coordination, dynamic stability, arc-flash, and harmonic studies.
cond_0060.responsibilities:
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the job description required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, distributed to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This includes reviewing and developing rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g., drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs, including upgrade and/or newbuild project support.
Close Requests for Engineering Action (REAs) assigned to you in a timely manner. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems, and liaising regularly with OEMs for development, bug-fixes, or required corrective actions.
Stay in close contact with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams to develop work scopes, and actively contribute to discussions on design requirements.
Work with OEMs to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to discuss and inspect equipment/system design and operation, and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Be available to provide 24-hour assistance to Technical Field Support in investigating equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, clarify design requirements, and assist with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Participate in and provide technical assistance during Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets), speaking up and initiating discussions to resolve issues early.
Provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Actively engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Support the Marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
This position requires strong interpersonal, analytical, and technical skills, as well as strong time-management skills — with a proven ability to work on multiple projects while handling ad-hoc priority incident investigations.

cond_0100.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0100.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree - Electrical Engineering or similar
7 - 10 Years in related field; Offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen.
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check.
Requires Offshore travel.

cond_0116.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection, and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
cond_0116.responsibilities:
Own the production of [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the work required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, for distribution to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This includes leading the review and development of rig procedures.
Deliver engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g., drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) to close assigned REAs, including Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support.
Take ownership of closing Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to you in a timely manner. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems, directing coordination with OEMs for development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, leading bug-fix resolution and required corrective actions, developing scopes of work, and driving alignment with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams.
Lead the review and recommendation of SW code updates/upgrades in coordination with OEMs, and determine applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design and operation, and lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Be available to provide 24-hour assistance to Technical Field Support in investigating equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, determine design requirements, and direct equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Lead and provide technical input in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Deliver expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Proactively research and engage with OEMs to build knowledge on new products and technologies, and advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB).
Support the Marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
This position requires strong interpersonal, analytical, and technical skills, as well as strong time-management skills — with a proven ability to manage multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc priority incident investigations.
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
7–10 Years of experience in a related field
Expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection
Offshore experience
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check
Requires offshore travel
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with power systems analysis tools covering Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies
Experience with Profibus/Profinet communication systems
Experience with variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPS, and Energy Storage systems

cond_0170.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection, and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
cond_0170.responsibilities:
Own the production of [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the work required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, for distribution to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This includes leading the review and development of rig procedures.
Deliver engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g., drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) to close assigned REAs, including Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support.
Take ownership of closing Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to you in a timely manner. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems, directing coordination with OEMs for development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, leading bug-fix resolution and required corrective actions, developing scopes of work, and driving alignment with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams.
Lead the review and recommendation of SW code updates/upgrades in coordination with OEMs, and determine applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design and operation, and lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Be available to provide 24-hour assistance to Technical Field Support in investigating equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, determine design requirements, and direct equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Lead and provide technical input in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Deliver expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Proactively research and engage with OEMs to build knowledge on new products and technologies, and advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB).
Support the Marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
This position requires strong interpersonal, analytical, and technical skills, as well as strong time-management skills — with a proven ability to manage multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc priority incident investigations.
cond_0170.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
7–10 Years of experience in a related field
Expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection
Offshore experience
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check
Requires offshore travel
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with power systems analysis tools covering Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies
Experience with Profibus/Profinet communication systems
Experience with variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPS, and Energy Storage systems

The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) short-circuit, protective devices coordination, dynamic stability, arc-flash, and harmonic studies.

Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the job description required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, for distribution to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. Develop scope of works and coordinate with operations electrical/drilling teams and projects teams on work scope development.
Review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades in coordination with OEMs, and provide input on applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design and operation, and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Provide 24-hour support to Technical Field Support for investigation of equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, review design requirements, and assist with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Provide technical input in incident reviews and investigations (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Provide expert input on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].

cond_0280.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0280.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree - Electrical Engineering or similar
7 - 10 Years in related field; Offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen.
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check.
Requires Offshore travel.

cond_0288.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role also requires the ability to coordinate on and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
cond_0288.responsibilities:
Work with engineering teams to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the job descriptions required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, to be distributed to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include collaborating on the review and development of rig procedures.
Coordinate with relevant teams to provide engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes supporting Upgrade and/or Newbuild projects as per assigned REAs.
Work alongside colleagues to close Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to this role in a timely manner. This includes reviewing existing equipment/systems design, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems, liaising with OEMs for the development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, supporting OEMs in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, developing scope of works, and coordinating with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of work scopes.
Work with OEMs to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and share expertise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to support testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Be available to provide 24hr assistance to Technical Field Support in the investigation of equipment/system failures to help prevent or minimize down-time.
Be available to travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to support testing, discuss design requirements, and assist with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Share expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans with relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Actively engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and help advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Support the Marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
This position also requires strong interpersonal, analytical, and technical skills, as well as strong time-management skills — with a proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc priority incident investigations.

The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) short-circuit, protective devices coordination, dynamic stability, arc-flash, and harmonic studies.
cond_0304.responsibilities:
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the job description required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, for distribution to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work includes the review and development of rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g., drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs, including upgrade and/or newbuild project support.
Close assigned Requests for Engineering Action (REA) in a timely manner. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems.
Coordinate with OEMs on the development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, including bug-fixes or required corrective actions.
Develop scope of works and coordinate with operations electrical/drilling teams and projects teams on work scope development.
Review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades in coordination with OEMs, and provide input on applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design and operation, and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Provide 24-hour support to Technical Field Support for investigation of equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, review design requirements, and assist with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Provide technical input in incident reviews and investigations (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Provide expert input on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Research new products and technologies and provide input on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet, coordinating with OEMs as needed.
Support the marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
Strong analytical, technical, and time-management skills are required, along with the ability to manage multiple projects while handling ad-hoc priority incident investigations.
cond_0304.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
7–10 Years in a related field; offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check
Requires offshore travel

cond_0329.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. Requires having the ability to run & review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, Harmonic studies. People generally become stronger in this kind of power systems engineering work over time as they build hands-on experience and learn from the field.
cond_0329.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.

cond_0352.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.

Requires having the ability to run & review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, Harmonic studies.
cond_0480.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as strong time-management skills – ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0480.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen.
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check.
Requires offshore travel.
cond_0480.encouragement_text:
Around 7–10 years of experience in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience. Relevant offshore experience and a background in rotating machinery, power systems control and protection are important, though candidates with strong foundational knowledge and a willingness to develop in these areas are encouraged to apply.

cond_0488.intro: This position requires deep expertise in the designs, industry standards, operation, protection and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role also requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
cond_0488.responsibilities:
Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs.
Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes.
Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time.
Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis' to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation.
Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB).
Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations.
This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or similar required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in power systems engineering in a related field.
Proven track record in offshore environments with deep knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.
Extensive expertise in the design, operation, protection, and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery, power switchboards, protection and control equipment, VFDs, DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, and Energy Storage systems.
Advanced knowledge of Profibus/Profinet communication systems.
Strong command of power systems analysis including Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen.
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check.
Requires offshore travel.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience liaising with OEMs on equipment development, bug-fixes, and corrective actions.
Proven track record reviewing and recommending SW code updates/upgrades for fleet-wide applicability.
Significant experience leading testing activities such as commissioning, FATs, and customer acceptance trials.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence across operations, projects, and vendor teams.
Strong leadership abilities in incident review and investigation processes (CATs, AARs, OERs).

cond_0529.responsibilities:
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the job description required to implement applicable OEM-issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, for distribution to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This includes review and development of rig procedures.
Provide engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g., drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs, including upgrade and/or newbuild project support.
Close assigned Requests for Engineering Action (REA) in a timely manner. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems.
Coordinate with OEMs on the development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, including support on bug-fixes or required corrective actions, and development of scope of works.
Coordinate with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams on the development of work scopes.
Review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades in coordination with OEMs, and provide input on applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design and operation, and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Provide 24-hour support to Technical Field Support for investigation of equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize downtime.
Travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, review design requirements, and assist with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Provide technical input in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Advise relevant departments within [Company name masked] on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans.
Research new products and technologies and provide input on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet, coordinating with OEMs as needed.
Coordinate with the Marketing department to review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations.
This position requires strong analytical and technical skills, as well as strong time-management skills — proven ability to manage multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc priority incident investigations is essential.
cond_0529.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
7–10 Years of experience in a related field
Expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection
Offshore experience
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check
Requires offshore travel
Preferred Requirements
Experience with power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), VFDs, DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, and energy storage systems
Familiarity with Profibus/Profinet communication systems
Ability to run and review power systems analysis studies (short-circuit, protective devices coordination, dynamic stability, arc-flash, harmonic)

cond_0570.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as strong time-management skills – ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.
cond_0570.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Must successfully complete pre-employment drug screen.
Must successfully complete pre-employment background check.
Requires offshore travel.
cond_0570.encouragement_text: Around 7–10 years of experience in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience. Relevant offshore experience and a background in rotating machinery, power systems control and protection are important, though candidates with strong foundational knowledge and a willingness to develop in these areas are encouraged to apply.

cond_0586.responsibilities: Will be responsible to produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) which will detail the Job Description required to implement the applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management as required to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This work will include the review and development of rig procedures. Provide engineering recommendation and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs. This also includes Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs. Will be responsible for closing in a timely manner the Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned to him/her. This work will include existing equipment/systems design review, produce drawings and documentation packages for new or upgrades to onboard equipment/systems, liaise with OEM for the development of new or upgrades equipment/systems, liaise with OEMs and provide active support in bug-fixes or required corrective actions, develop scope of works, liaise with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of the work scopes. Work with OEM to review and recommend SW code updates/upgrades and provide expertise on applicability to [Company name masked] existing fleet. Travel to offshore vessels, to shore based OEMs facilities or to shipyards to discuss/inspect equipment/system design/operation and to lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgrades equipment, FATs, customer acceptance). Will be available to provide 24hrs assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failure to prevent or minimize down-time. Will be available to travel on an 'as needed basis's to offshore operating vessels and/or to onshore to vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, discuss design requirements and assist/advise with equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting and operation. Will participate and provide technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets). Will provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul and exchanges plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked]. Will actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and be able to advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet. Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB). Will support the Marketing department, review proposals/requirements and provide technical recommendations. This position will also require very strong inter-personal, analytical and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills – proven ability to work on multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigation is essential.

7 - 10 Years in related field; Offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.

cond_0647.intro: This position requires expert knowledge of the designs, industry standards, operation, protection and testing/commissioning of rotating electrical machinery (motors/generators), power switchboards (11kVAC and lower AC voltages), protection and control equipment (circuit breakers, relays, fuses, PLCs, etc.), variable frequency drives (VFD), DC bus voltage regulation, UPSs, Energy Storage systems, Profibus/Profinet communication systems fitted onboard [Company name masked] vessels. The role requires the ability to run and review power systems analysis, including (but not limited to) Short-Circuit, Protective Devices Coordination, Dynamic Stability, Arc-Flash, and Harmonic studies.
cond_0647.responsibilities:
Produce [Company name masked] Technical Bulletins (TIB) detailing the Job Description required to implement applicable OEM issued bulletins or other actions approved by [Company name masked] Engineering management, to be distributed as TIB to applicable rigs within [Company name masked]'s fleet. This includes leading the review and development of rig procedures.
Deliver engineering recommendations and produce required documentation (e.g.: drawings, schematic and one-line diagrams, functional specifications, installation/troubleshooting/maintenance procedures, work-packs, power systems analysis) for closing assigned REAs, including Upgrade and/or Newbuild project support as per assigned REAs.
Own the timely closure of Requests for Engineering Action (REA) assigned. This includes existing equipment/systems design review, producing drawings and documentation packages for new or upgraded onboard equipment/systems, leading engagement with OEMs for the development of new or upgraded equipment/systems, driving bug-fixes or required corrective actions with OEMs, developing scope of works, and directing coordination with Operations electrical/drilling teams and Projects teams for the development of work scopes.
Lead review and recommendation of SW code updates/upgrades with OEMs and determine applicability to [Company name masked]'s existing fleet.
Travel to offshore vessels, shore-based OEM facilities, or shipyards to inspect equipment/system design/operation and lead testing activities (annual trials, commissioning of new/upgraded equipment, FATs, customer acceptance).
Be available to provide 24hr assistance to Technical Field Support in investigation of equipment/system failures to prevent or minimize down-time.
Be available to travel on an as-needed basis to offshore operating vessels and/or onshore vendor facilities or shipyards to lead testing, determine design requirements, and advise on equipment/systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation.
Participate and deliver technical assistance in Incident Review and Investigation (CATs, AARs, OERs, TFS tickets).
Provide expert advice on equipment obsolescence, overhaul, and exchange plans to relevant departments within [Company name masked].
Actively research and engage with OEMs to gather knowledge on new products and technologies and advise on applicability to [Company name masked]'s fleet.
Support the Marketing department by reviewing proposals/requirements and providing technical recommendations.
This position requires very strong inter-personal, analytical, and technical skills as well as very strong time-management skills — proven ability to manage multiple projects while addressing ad-hoc top priority incident investigations is essential.

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar.
7–10 Years in a related field; offshore experience and expert knowledge of rotating machinery, power systems control and protection.
